fields.statement: At 63456160 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/tui/inboxapp/... (ok, fake runner only; vet and gofmt clean) and read the diff. TestGateFormScrollsLongQuestions: four ~400-char questions in a 70x30 window show the form within 30 rows with END4 hidden; page-down and then the mouse wheel (MouseMode on) reveal END4 while 'Your answer to question 1 of 4' stays visible; four answers then submit 1+4+1 calls ending in run.resume and quit. TestGateUnreadableQuestionShowsPositionNotHandle: an empty statement shows 'question 2 of 4: This question's text could not be read.' and 'Your answer to question 2 of 4', with no q-handle anywhere. TestGateAnswersEachThenResumes checks question.answer <handle> <text> --run R4 per question then run.resume; TestGateBlankAnswerSendsNothing: blank calls nothing. TestGateAnswerFailureReopensOnRemaining: a failed answer reopens on the remaining questions with 'answer failed: disk full' and no run.resume. TestGateResumeFailureDetailScrolls: a failed resume shows 'resume failed: busy' in a ui.InfoPanel sized to the window (wheel-scrolled by Model.Update). TestDetailPanelScrolls: a long stalled-item detail is clipped, page-down reaches LASTWORD, wheel-up scrolls back.
